clear_width_mm.description: Minimum clear useable width, when open, of the narrowest exterior passenger doorway.
clear_width_mm.title: Clear Width Mm

wheelchair_door_clear_width_mm.description: Minimum clear useable width, when open, of the doorways designated for wheelchair access.
wheelchair_door_clear_width_mm.title: Wheelchair Door Clear Width Mm

wheelchair_door_level_access.description: Whether the wheelchair access doorways give level access as the TSI defines it (gap to the platform at most 75 mm horizontal and 50 mm vertical, no internal step between sill and vestibule).
wheelchair_door_level_access.title: Wheelchair Door Level Access

outside_diameter_mm.description: Outside diameter of the handrails, if all are the same (else the one furthest from 30-40 mm).
outside_diameter_mm.title: Outside Diameter Mm

cushion_height_mm.description: Height of the top of the priority seat cushion above floor level at its front edge (the one furthest from 430-500 mm, if they differ).
cushion_height_mm.title: Cushion Height Mm

Renewal.description: What a renewal or upgrade changed (Appendix F): the exemptions depend on it.

seating_layout_altered_in_entire_vehicle.description: The seating layout was altered within at least one entire vehicle.
seating_layout_altered_in_entire_vehicle.title: Seating Layout Altered In Entire Vehicle

seating_layout_altered_in_entire_train.description: The seating layout was altered within the entire train (complete formation).
seating_layout_altered_in_entire_train.title: Seating Layout Altered In Entire Train

handrails_renewed.description: Existing handrails are being renewed or upgraded.
handrails_renewed.title: Handrails Renewed

toilets_completely_renewed.description: Existing toilets are being completely renewed or upgraded.
toilets_completely_renewed.title: Toilets Completely Renewed

Renewal.title: Renewal

step_height_mm.description: Height of the highest internal step, other than steps for external access.
step_height_mm.title: Step Height Mm

step_depth_mm.description: Smallest depth of an internal step, other than steps for external access, at the central axis of the stairs.
step_depth_mm.title: Step Depth Mm

external_step_height_mm.description: Height of the highest external access step, fixed or moveable.
external_step_height_mm.title: External Step Height Mm

internal_step_height_mm.description: Height of the highest internal step used for external access.
internal_step_height_mm.title: Internal Step Height Mm

universal.description: Of those, toilets designed as universal toilets.
universal.title: Universal

universal_door_clear_width_mm.description: Clear useable width of the universal toilet access door.
universal_door_clear_width_mm.title: Universal Door Clear Width Mm

width_mm.description: Width of the wheelchair space over its full length, from floor level to 1 450 mm, not counting any hand clearance.
width_mm.title: Width Mm

sides_next_to_obstacle.description: Sides of the wheelchair space (0, 1 or 2) next to a wall or structure that would inhibit the user's hands; a side open to the aisle does not count.
sides_next_to_obstacle.title: Sides Next To Obstacle

hand_clearance_mm.description: Smallest additional width for the user's hands, 400 to 800 mm above floor level, on a side next to an obstacle.
hand_clearance_mm.title: Hand Clearance Mm

turning_space_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the wheelchair turning space next to the wheelchair space.
turning_space_diameter_mm.title: Turning Space Diameter Mm

unit_length_m.description: Length of the unit in metres, excluding any locomotive or power head (the basis the TSI uses for the wheelchair-space table).
unit_length_m.title: Unit Length M

length_includes_power_head.description: Set true if unit_length_m includes a locomotive or power head: the length is then not on the TSI's basis.
length_includes_power_head.title: Length Includes Power Head

design_speed_kmh.description: Design speed of the train in km/h.
design_speed_kmh.title: Design Speed Kmh

deck_layout.description: Whether the unit has one passenger deck or two.
deck_layout.title: Deck Layout

unit_status.description: new: placed on the market (the TSI's default case); renewed: an existing unit being renewed or upgraded, to which the exemptions of Appendix F may apply.
unit_status.title: Unit Status

wheelchair_spaces.description: Accessible wheelchair spaces in the unit.
wheelchair_spaces.title: Wheelchair Spaces
